items.title: Attackers Abuse ChatGPT Custom GPTs to Deliver RAT via ClickFix
items.content: Threat actors are exploiting ChatGPT Custom GPTs and Google Sites to deliver remote access trojans through a sophisticated multi-stage attack chain. The campaign uses sponsored Google search results to direct victims to attacker-created Custom GPTs that impersonate legitimate ChatGPT models. Victims are then redirected to a malicious Google Sites page presenting a fake CloudFlare CAPTCHA that... This pulse includes 22 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: Lumma Stealer, MacSync, SectopRAT.

items.title: Node2Shell / HTTP2Shell Vulnerability May Allow RCE
items.content: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Google's Brotli decoder, tracked as CVE-2026-111497 and known as Node2Shell or HTTP2Shell, affects Node.js and various other software packages. The critical flaw (CVSS 9.2) can be triggered when vulnerable processes decompress attacker-controlled Brotli data, potentially leading to crashes, memory disclosure, or remote code execution. items.title: n0n Ransomware: Inside an AI-Assisted Extortion Operation
items.content: In September 2026, an exposed staging server revealed the complete operational workspace of a n0n ransomware operator, including breach tools, encryptor source code, extortion infrastructure, and an AI coding agent environment with over $7,000 in paid LLM API usage.
